data.one_liner: Web-based SQLite workbench for debugging databases in Flutter and Dart apps.
data.what_it_does: Starts a local HTTP server providing a web-based SQLite workbench UI during development. Allows developers to inspect tables, execute queries, view database structure, edit data, and manage schema live from any browser.
use_when: You need to inspect and debug SQLite databases during Flutter or Dart app development.
You want a MySQL Workbench-style browser interface to run queries and view table data on mobile or desktop apps.
avoid_when: You are building production releases (must be kept out of production builds).
Your app does not use SQLite databases.
strengths: Tab-based workspace supporting multiple databases and tables.
Includes SQL autocomplete, syntax highlighting, and destructive query protection.
Accessible from any browser on your local network via a built-in server.
weaknesses: Development-only tool requiring careful exclusion from production codebases.
Relies on external browser access to view data.
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies and call enableWorkbench() on your database instance.
